name: timeline
title: Timeline
author: Lambda Curry <https://github.com/lambda-curry>
description: A vertical timeline of dated entries on a rail, with an optional current entry and labels in their own column on wide screens.

meta.useWhen: Dates or phases carry the meaning: a company history, a project schedule or an event programme.
meta.avoidWhen: There are fewer than three entries, or the dates add nothing. A paragraph is clearer.
